name: Pratham Bhavsar
about: I started out writing Flutter apps and moved to backends because that's where the interesting problems were. These days I mostly write Rust (axum, SQLx) and Go, with Postgres underneath and React or Next.js on top.

Lately I've been building open-source tools I'd want to use myself: an affiliate engine, a self-hosted support inbox, a study tool, and a terminal workspace for running coding agents. Some client work sits next to those, mostly content-distribution systems.

experience.desc: Backend and web work, including the deploy pipeline, so releases don't need someone awake to babysit them.
Part of a seven-person dev collective that takes on client work: backends, content pipelines and apps. Small teams, short cycles, shipped to production.
Flutter apps on the money side, where a wrong number on screen turns into a support ticket.
Shipped production Flutter apps for clients and wired AI chat features into them.
First real codebase: fixing UI bugs and chasing down why a screen felt slow, one profile trace at a time.
